## Summary

One to two sentence summary of the change. What does this PR do and why?

## Problem

Describe the problem being solved. Include context, background, and any relevant references (spec links, issue numbers, etc.).

## Solution

Describe the approach taken. Highlight key design decisions and trade-offs.

## Changes

- Bullet list of concrete changes (files/components modified, added, or removed)
- Include relevant paths or module names

## Verification

How was this change verified? List relevant test commands and expected outcomes.

- [ ] Tests pass (`npm run test`)
- [ ] Lint passes (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Build passes (`npm run build`)

## Checklist

- [ ] Commits follow conventional commit format (e.g., `fix(scope): description`)
- [ ] Commits are GPG-signed
- [ ] Spec alignment: changes match the approved specification (if applicable)
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable)
